Guardian products generally refer to offerings from **Guardian Healthcare** (the retail pharmacy and wellness chain in India known for private labels and [GNC](https://www.apollopharmacy.in/HEALTH%20&%20NUTRITION/Guardian%20Healthcare%20Services%20Pvt%20Ltd-manufacturer) products), regional entities like **Guardian Healthcare Ltd** in Bangladesh, or local alternative medicine makers. [](https://www.guardianbd.com/)

- **Vitamins & Supplements:** Fish oil, daily multivitamins, and antioxidant formulas.

- **Sports Nutrition:** Whey protein, mass gainers, BCAA, and creatine (including GNC AMP and Pro series).

- **Guardian Brands (Private Labels):** Over 300 SKUs spanning personal care, baby care, and ayurvedic lines under umbrellas like _Xtracare_, _Xtraveda_, and _Xtraslim_. [](https://guardianpharmacy.co.in/)

### Guardian Healthcare Ltd (Bangladesh) Pharmaceuticals

- **Antibiotics & Antimicrobials:**

_Azee_ (Azithromycin), _Cemaxi_ (Cefixime), _Ciproguard_ (Ciprofloxacin), and _Fightex_ (Cefuroxime).

- **Pain & Inflammation:** _Maxpain_ (Aceclofenac) and _Ketoxguard_ (Ketorolac).

- **Gastric & Respiratory Care:** _Esoclip_ (Esomeprazole), _Gavigard_, and _Lungair_ (Montelukast).
